title: Export the map data (GeoJSON)
intro: Download the circle's map data as GeoJSON files, which map tools such as uMap can import. Both files hold only the recommendations every member sees, without private or hidden ones; every member downloads the same content.

places.description: Places layer: name, aliases, position and precision, position note, landmark, category and cuisine of the places with at least one recommendation for the circle. No member information.
places.license: Licence: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0. Positions are placed on OpenStreetMap: © OpenStreetMap contributors.

recommendations.description: Recommendations layer: each recommendation's signature (main name or pseudonym), attitude, text, dishes, time slots, sources and visit date, at its place's position. Not who wrote or edited it.
recommendations.license: Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0), attributed to each recommendation's signature.

error: The export failed. Check the network and try again.
